description: Registered dispatch returns data.job_id and data.status=queued before operation preflight. Read service_interface::job_service::get_job by that exact id until terminal: job.result is the complete original operation response and job.error retains a failure. Direct internal Python calls keep their complete synchronous results. Admission persists a bounded descriptor; loss of its owner-memory body requires reconciliation without automatic replay. Read-only enumeration of the platform's quality-gate registry and its smoke-test register. Returns every gate the server knows (name, kind, description, timeout_seconds, whether it is directly runnable via run_gate or only through the 'code_quality' aggregate) plus the list of repo-relative smoke paths parsed from the effective register, which is quality_gates/gate_smokes.txt unioned with every fragment under quality_gates/gate_smokes.d/. Every gate has timeout_seconds=null because no per-gate execution deadline is configured. Executes NOTHING — this is pure discovery so a caller can pick a valid gate name for run_gate or a registered smoke path for run_test. The registry is baked server-side; there is no free-form input.
embedding_description: List Quality Gates through an owned quality-service worker. Registered dispatch returns a canonical job id before registry, Git, hash, proof or campaign preflight. Retrieve its exact id for the original result or error; internal calls stay synchronous and uncertain effects are never replayed.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Submission: data.job_id and data.status. Terminal job.result: Object with 'gates' (per-gate rows), 'smokes' (registered smoke paths), and 'smoke_count'.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Present the gate names with their kind and whether they are directly runnable. Note that the coherence trio (god_class/radon_cc/radon_mi) runs via the 'code_quality' aggregate.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Keep the exact job id. Retrieve job_service.get_job until terminal before consuming operation fields; do not repeat effects after owner loss or an uncertain terminal write. Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Enumerating the server-side quality-gate registry and reading the tracked smoke register (quality_gates/gate_smokes.txt and its fragment directory quality_gates/gate_smokes.d/).
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: FileNotFoundError: the repo venv or the main smoke register is missing (a missing fragment directory is normal and never an error) — the plugin is not running from a complete platform repo tree. RuntimeError: repo root could not be located (no ancestor carries both quality_gates/ and .git).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Confirm the solet is running from a checked-out platform repo (quality_gates/ and .git present) with a populated .venv. This verb takes no arguments; a failure indicates an environment problem, not a bad input.
